title: First General Census of the Russian Empire, 1897. Vol. XIII. Ekaterinoslav Governorate
publisher: Central Statistical Committee of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, 1904
rights: Historical public-domain census tables. Numerical transcription only.
scope: Ekaterinoslav Governorate. Persons present of both sexes, including children and those of unknown age.

extraction.locator: Vol. XIII, table V, p. 30, province total. Распредѣленіе населенія по полу, возрасту и семейному состоянію. Въ губерніи, ИТОГО.
extraction.method: Transcribe male and female totals for never married, married, widowed, divorced and status not reported. The five entries for each sex close to the province census totals. Unreported status remains unassigned. No age cross-tabulation is used at opening.
